start.content: The man who was healed — he was brought to the priests immediately. The elders questioned him closely. Not about the healing, but about the voice.

elders.content: They wanted to know who had healed him. When he said "Jesus of Nazareth," some of them began to question whether such a thing was possible on the Sabbath.

testimony.content: He told them the plain truth: he had never seen, but now he sees. That was enough to make the Pharisees call a council meeting.

closing.content: The conversation is over. Go in peace.
